steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each accelerator and threshold is placed by its cap and its cost against last year's data.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Accelerator with no cap and no cost estimate
findings.fix: Cap the accelerator and estimate its cost

findings.title: Threshold above what last year's data shows
findings.fix: Reset the threshold to the data

findings.title: Mix pays more than the cost of sale allows

outcome.notChecked: Whether the plan is lawful; its effect on behaviour beyond the data.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] accel-tier-2.md:12  Accelerator with no cap and no cost estimate.
       Fix: Cap the accelerator and estimate its cost.
[medium] threshold-quota.md:19  Threshold above what last year's data shows.
       Fix: Reset the threshold to the data.
[low] cost-of-sale.md:26  Mix pays more than the cost of sale allows.

pros: Checks an accelerator with no cap and no cost estimate, a mix that pays more than the cost of sale allows, and a threshold that the last year's data shows is unreachable.
cons: Not checked: Whether the plan is lawful; its effect on behaviour beyond the data.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-sales-compensation-plan-review skill on the records for this review.
